Apple TV just added a total of 15 classic movies to its library, available for subscribers to watch for free. Here's the complete list.

Apple TV adds 15 classic movies available for streaming

Apple TV has always focused on original series and movies, with very little licensed content on the platform. But last month Apple surprised us by adding multiple classic films, such as The Fugitive, E.T., The Rookie, and more.

Now Apple is continuing the momentum, with another 15 brand-new classic movies added today.

Here's the full list of all newly added films:

  • The Social Network
  • War of the Worlds
  • School of Rock
  • Her
  • Ferris Bueller's Day Off
  • Superbad
  • Mamma Mia! the movie
  • Definitely, Maybe
  • Easy A
  • Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
  • A League of Their Own
  • Troy
  • Frost/Nixon
  • 00:30 A Midnight Operation
  • The Wolf of Wall Street

Just like last month's movie additions, availability may vary depending on the viewer's location. However, the 15 films above are already available to U.S. viewers.

The only bad news is that Apple has also removed quite a few movies that were streaming last month. While a small number have been kept, most are no longer available to watch.

It is currently unclear whether these latest additions will also have a viewing window, so if you spot something you like, you may want to watch it soon.

More Apple original series and movies are coming in September — here's everything arriving then.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, and you can also get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
